fact: A programme backed by the AFD with 27.3 million euros from 2019 provides for electronic medical records and digital archives in Tunisian public hospitals, after 16 hospitals joined a unified medical information system by 2017; on 2 November 2026 the minister discussed the digital hospital and electronic record with Spain.
title: Santé numérique : la Tunisie explore des pistes de coopération avec l'Espagne
